extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store.

extDescription.message: Names your tabs after your bookmarks: open a bookmarked page and its tab shows the bookmark's name.
extDescription.description: Short description shown in the browser and the store (max 132 characters).

popupUnsupportedBody.message: The browser doesn't let extensions change this page.

popupNoBookmarkBody.message: Bookmark it and the tab takes the name you give it.

openedFrom.message: Shown because this tab opened this bookmark's address earlier.

optionsIntro.message: For each bookmark, choose where its name is used: only on its own address, also on the pages under it, on pages whose address contains some text, or on the whole site.

optionsCount.message: Bookmarks that also name other pages: $ON$ of $TOTAL$

optionsNoMatchBody.message: Try another name, address or folder.

optionsNoBookmarksBody.message: Bookmark a page (Ctrl+D, or ⌘D on a Mac) and it shows up here.

menuScope_exact.message: Use the name only on this address

menuScope_below.message: Use the name on this address and the pages under it

menuScope_contains.message: Use the name on pages whose address contains “$TEXT$”

menuScope_containsEmpty.message: Use the name on pages whose address contains…

menuScope_host.message: Use the name on the whole site ($HOST$)

appendTitleHint.message: The tab shows “bookmark name — page title”, e.g. “Mail — (3) Inbox”. Applies to all bookmarks except those with their own setting (the “Page title” switch in a row or in the popup).

pageTitleHint.message: Show the page's own title after this bookmark's name. Overrides the setting for all bookmarks.

backupHint.message: Save all these settings to a file, or load them from one, for example in another browser. Settings apply to every bookmark with the same address.

importSummary.message: The file has settings for $TOTAL$ addresses: $MATCH$ match your bookmarks, and $OTHER$ will apply once you bookmark those addresses.

importErrorFile.message: This is not a Bookmark-Tab Title settings file.

importErrorSize.message: The file is too large (over 5 MB).

importErrorQuota.message: There isn't enough room in the browser's synced storage for these settings. Nothing was changed.

bookmarkOnLabel.message: Use this bookmark's name in the tab

onAllHint.message: When it's off, every tab shows the page's own title again. To turn off a single bookmark, use the switch at the start of its row or in the popup.

containsHint.message: Works for links opened from email too. Separate several texts with spaces.

howIntro.message: When a page is bookmarked, its tab shows the bookmark's name instead of the page title. For each bookmark, you choose where the name is used:

howExact.message: Only on the bookmarked address itself.

howBelow.message: Once the tab has opened the bookmarked address, also on every page under it, e.g. example.com/docs and then example.com/docs/guide.

howContains.message: On every page of the bookmark's site whose address contains the text, in any tab, including links opened from email. Handy when you have several accounts: /u/1/ or authuser=1 on Google, a developer ID in Play Console, project=… in Google Cloud. Separate several texts with spaces.

howHost.message: Once the tab has opened the bookmarked address, on every page of the site.

howWins.message: The most specific one wins: first the page's own bookmark, then “Pages whose address contains”, then “This address and below”, and last the most recent “The whole site” bookmark the tab has opened. After a page that has its own bookmark, the next page goes back to the whole-site name.

howTrail.message: “This address and below” and “The whole site” stop when the tab leaves the site; a link opened in a new tab keeps them. The setting is shared: you can change it here, in the popup, or by right-clicking a page.
